execution_note: Five local seeds, 500 contexts per seed, 10 actions per context.
decoder_access: all current clauses + selected variable + target phase + W before/after; selected clause index hidden

test_design.alias_definition: same absolute variable set and same clause[0] sign; different non-first literal signs

decoded_logic.structural_trace: changed W pairs reveal the three-variable set of the acted-on clause
decoded_logic.target_filter: Gate-10C rule filters candidates by clause[0] sign
decoded_logic.decision: return the unique compatible clause if exactly one remains; otherwise return NOT_IDENTIFIABLE with the full compatible set

interpretation.positive: The downstream structural trace reduces the mean clause candidate set from 2.58 to 1.33 and raises unique identification from 22.2% to 66.6%. Whenever the declared observations uniquely determine a clause, the decoder identifies it correctly.
interpretation.identifiability_result: The remaining one-third of events were deliberately constructed aliases that share the exact observable signature under this intervention family. The decoder returns NOT_IDENTIFIABLE on those cases and matches the ground-truth identifiability class 100% of the time.
interpretation.why_it_matters: This is the first gate where refusing to provide a unique explanation is part of passing. It imports the TransientWaveCompiler gauge/identifiability lesson directly into policy decoding.
interpretation.scope_limit: The aliases are cleanly engineered and the W support is noiseless. Real neural systems will require graded/noise-aware equivalence rather than exact matching.
